# ADR-3040: A04: Unauthenticated state-changing RPC for action 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

CSRF-like gaps appear when auth is optional on writes.

## Decision

Services MUST NOT expose an unauthenticated state-changing RPC for action 4 (A04-4).

## Consequences

Mutations require authn plus anti-forgery controls.
